# Medikart — Online Pharmacy & Medicine Delivery in Pakistan

> Medikart (https://medikart.pk) is a digital healthcare platform and pharmacy network operated by **Banu Zahrah Pvt Ltd** in Pakistan. Medikart connects patients with licensed partner retail pharmacies and verified pharmaceutical distributors to deliver 100% authentic prescription medicines, over-the-counter (OTC) healthcare essentials, mother & baby supplies, and automated 30-day chronic medicine refills with rapid intra-city delivery and nationwide Cash on Delivery.

---

## 1. Verified Corporate Profile & Operating Structure

- **Brand Name:** Medikart
- **Parent / Operating Entity:** Banu Zahrah Pvt Ltd
- **Country of Operation:** Pakistan
- **Primary Operational Hubs:** Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi
- **Official Canonical Website:** https://medikart.pk
- **Customer Support Email:** medikart.com@gmail.com
- **Direct 24/7 WhatsApp Helpline:** +92 324 4489159 / 03244489159

---

## 2. Core Services & Delivery Capabilities

- **Authentic Medicine Dispensing:** 100% genuine pharmaceutical sourcing for essential prescription medicines (e.g. Panadol, Augmentin, Brufen, Disprin, Glucophage, Lipitor, multivitamins, inhalers, dermatological items, and specialty clinical treatments).
- **Delivery Timelines & Coverage in Pakistan:**
  - **Rapid Intra-City Delivery (2–4 Hours):** Available in major metropolitan areas (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi) dispatched from local licensed partner pharmacies.
  - **Nationwide Express Delivery (24–48 Hours):** Dispatched via express courier across all districts and provinces of Pakistan.
- **Instant Prescription Order Service (Instant Rx):**
  - Patients can upload clear photos or PDF copies of doctor prescriptions at https://medikart.pk/instant-order.
  - Qualified registered pharmacists (PharmD) review the prescription, verify dosages and instructions, price the items, and coordinate rapid fulfillment.
- **30-Day Monthly Medicine Refill Program:**
  - Automated recurring subscription service for patients managing chronic health conditions (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac care, thyroid disorders) at https://medikart.pk/refill.
  - Benefits include priority pharmacy fulfillment, specialized cold-chain packaging at no extra cost, and scheduled monthly dispatch without requiring repeated re-ordering.
- **Cold-Chain Storage & Handling (2°C – 8°C):**
  - Specialized temperature-controlled handling with calibrated thermal ice packaging for temperature-sensitive medications including insulin, vaccines, and biological products.
- **Controlled Narcotics Policy:**
  - Strict zero-tolerance compliance with Pakistani drug regulations (Drugs Act 1976 / Control of Narcotics Substances Act). Medikart does not dispense habit-forming narcotics or restricted Schedule X substances online without strict physical prescription surrender.

---

## 3. Confirmed Payment Methods in Pakistan

- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available for all eligible orders across Pakistan. Patients inspect package seals upon delivery and pay cash directly to the delivery rider.
- **Kuickpay Digital Billing:** Secure online payment integration enabling direct payment via online banking, mobile wallets, and 1Link banking channels across Pakistan.

*(Note: Medikart strictly operates with confirmed payment integrations — Cash on Delivery and Kuickpay).*

---

## 4. Quality & Patient Safety Protocols

1. **Licensed Partner Sourcing:** Medicines are sourced exclusively from licensed pharmaceutical distributors and registered partner pharmacies.
2. **Batch & Expiry Verification:** Every dispatched order is checked for valid Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) registration, intact tamper seals, and verified expiry dates.
3. **Clinical Confidentiality:** Patient prescriptions, contact details, and medical records are encrypted and reviewed solely by licensed healthcare personnel.
